from pathlib import Path
from sqlalchemy import create_engine,text
values=dict(line.split('=',1) for line in Path('.env.dev').read_text().splitlines() if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'))
engine=create_engine(values['MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL'],hide_parameters=True)
with engine.connect() as c:
    counts={name:c.execute(text('SELECT count(*) FROM app.'+name)).scalar_one() for name in ['users','tenants','memberships','stores']}
    result={'foundation_rows_after_cleanup':counts,'alembic_revision':c.execute(text('SELECT version_num FROM app.alembic_version')).scalar_one(),'pgvector_version':c.execute(text(SELECT" extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='vector')).scalar_one(),'provider_schemas':list(c.execute(text(SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name IN ('auth','storage') ORDER BY "schema_name)).scalars())}
    assert result['alembic_revision']=='0001'
    assert all(value==0 for value in counts.values())
    assert result['provider_schemas']==['auth','storage']
engine.dispose()
print(json.dumps(result))"
